proves.claim: A land receipt through applyLandingReceipt that lands sprint items 1, 2 and 3 queues one review job for each, id review:<item>, kind review, step queued.

api.gate.landed-review.one-per-sprint-it.why: Without it a landed sprint item has no review job until a reviewer happens to reserve it, so it cannot be offered or counted.

proves.claim: A landing of steady items queues no review job and prepares no review board call.

api.gate.landed-review.steady-none.why: Steady items are reviewed before landing; a queued job for them would be noise and an added board call on every landing.

proves.claim: A second receipt makes no second review job and leaves a job a reviewer has reserved as it is.

api.gate.landed-review.once.why: A duplicate or reset job would drop a live reviewer lease.

proves.claim: reserveReview on an item that already holds its queued review job takes the lease and returns reserved true; the landed sprint item is offered before it.

api.gate.landed-review.reserve-after-que.why: Queuing at landing must not break the reservation path the review pick uses.
